summary.text: Robert Quattrocchi is a Republican who represents House District 41, which includes all of Scituate and part of Cranston, and has served in the Rhode Island House since November 2016; he is Deputy Minority Whip.

paragraphs.text: Quattrocchi serves on the House Oversight, Municipal Government and Housing, and Special Legislation committees.

He was a partner in Quatro Brothers Concrete Finishing and is the former owner of Quatro Motorcycle Company; he graduated from Scituate High School in 1981 and the American Motorcycle Institute in Daytona, Florida.

His biography lists membership in the Scituate Lions Club, the Pine Tree Gun Club in Foster and the Sons and Daughters of Italy, and says he was born December 11, 1963, is married to Edwina and has two daughters.
